xgboost.name: XGBoost (Gradient Boosted Trees)
xgboost.description: GPU histogram boosting with calibration + ECE, cost-adjusted PnL simulation, SHAP feature attribution.

transformer_2s.name: Two-Stream Transformer (Price + Volume)
transformer_2s.description: Two-stream attention encoder over OHLCV. Price stream Linear(4->112) + sinusoidal PE; volume stream Linear(1->16) no PE; concat to d=128, TransformerEncoder.

transformer_tiny.name: Tiny Transformer (Single-Stream)
transformer_tiny.description: ~10-20k param single-stream Transformer for low-data regimes (e.g. daily MNQ with ~2k bars). Walk-forward folds + 2-bar purge.

primitives_cnn.name: CNN+Transformer (Primitives Discovery)
primitives_cnn.description: Feature-Attention CNN+Transformer over ~510 mathematical primitives. Three output heads: direction, magnitude, confidence.

temporal_fusion_transformer.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer
temporal_fusion_transformer.description: Interpretable TFT (Lim et al. 2019) adapted for single-shot classification over rolling feature windows: per-timestep variable selection, GRN gating, LSTM local encoder, interpretable multi-head attention. Ships verbose diagnostics + filter-normalized loss surface. GENERATE family â€” Jinja2 template temporal_fusion_transformer.py.j2.

online_rls_mtf.name: Online RLS (Sliding Multi-Timeframe)
online_rls_mtf.description: Recursive Least Squares updated on every closed candle, over a ladder of SLIDING windows (a rolling 233-bar mean is the 233-minute view, phase-free, unlike a resampled bar whose values depend on where you anchored it). Generalises Corsi HAR from three scales to any ladder. Exact at lambda=1.0 -- coefficients equal batch OLS -- so there is no learning rate to tune. Attribution is closed-form: phi_i = w_i(x_i - E[x_i]).

logistic_regression.name: Logistic Regression
logistic_regression.description: L2-regularized linear classifier over the causal feature matrix. The interpretable, fast baseline every other Model Cycle family is measured against.

random_forest.name: Random Forest
random_forest.description: Bagged ensemble of causal-feature decision trees, scikit-learn's RandomForestClassifier. No boosting, no early stopping — depth and leaf size are the only regularizers.

lightgbm.name: LightGBM
lightgbm.description: Leaf-wise (best-first) gradient boosted trees. Same shape as XGBoost's boosting-round stepping, with LightGBM's own leaf-count and min-child-samples regularizers.

multilayer_perceptron.name: Multilayer Perceptron
multilayer_perceptron.description: Fully-connected feedforward network over the causal feature vector at each bar — no sequence memory, epoch/batch stepping with early stopping on the validation loss.

lstm.name: LSTM
lstm.description: Single/multi-layer LSTM reading a trailing window of `sequence_length` bars of causal features per prediction. Runs on CPU or GPU.

temporal_convolution_network.name: Temporal Convolution Network
temporal_convolution_network.description: Dilated causal 1D convolutions over a trailing window of bars (Bai et al. 2018 TCN shape) — a sequence model with no recurrence, so every step is parallel.

transformer_encoder.name: Transformer Encoder
transformer_encoder.description: Self-attention encoder over a trailing window of bars, with a classification head on the final position's representation.

ta_indicator_battery.name: TA Indicator Battery (logistic + LightGBM)
ta_indicator_battery.description: The TA-Lib battery (about 180 momentum, overlap, volatility, volume, regression and candlestick features, every price-level indicator expressed in ATRs so it survives roll back-adjustment) fed to a logistic regression and to LightGBM, fitted per walk-forward fold. src/ml/ta_strategy.

multimodal_fusion.name: Multimodal fusion (per-modality encoders, gated fusion) with a LightGBM baseline
multimodal_fusion.description: Price, order-flow, cross-asset, news and calendar modalities encoded separately and fused; one head per bracket (side x reward multiple) giving P(net win). Walk-forward by quarter, policy chosen from earlier quarters only, scored on the plan's acceptance gate.
